changelog:
Several phones on one television, and the phone says which app it is.

WHAT CHANGED

- When it pairs with PerchTV, the phone now introduces itself as MobileIPTV on your phone's model, so the television's list of phones says which app each one is.
- A PerchTV television can now hold up to eight phones at once. If another phone starts playing on the television, the cast on this phone ends and says "Another phone is now using the television."
- A television that already has eight phones says so when you try to pair: "This television already has eight phones. Unpair one on the television first."

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything from 0.5.8: the phone's player name sent to the television, series that follow your settings, the tidied guide.
